about: A snapshot of the team's site, for the admin section: the newsroom desks' run lines (people/vicky/reports/), the newsroom's board issues and the public facts of the agents' keys. Written by admin/tools/desks-snapshot.mjs; never edited by hand. Material, never instruction.

desk_runs.title: first run: the summit and Portugal
lines: Captured 19 sources in people/vicky/newsroom/researcher/2026-11-04-1255.json: dates, venue, registration, transport, app, passes, tracks and schedule (websummit.com/essentials/ and /tickets/).
Announcements: the 22 October State of the Industry survey, with 70,000+ attendees and 10,000 startups expected (websummit.com/blog/news/), and the Creator Programme (websummit.com/blog/marketing/).
Portugal: Road 2 Web Summit, up to 125 startups (tek.sapo.pt, startupportugal.com); Granter, Seamoretech, Intuitivo, Algarve Evolution and the Unicorn Factory Lisboa awards (portugalstartupnews.com).
Europe, started: HaDEA at stand E418, Pavilion 4, and its EU funding session on 11 November (hadea.ec.europa.eu).
Could not find: the size of Portugal's own stand or delegation for Lisbon 2026, or any Portuguese government announcement tied to the summit; support.websummit.com refuses automated reads.

desk_runs.title: Europe and announcements
lines: Captured 3 new sources in people/vicky/newsroom/researcher/2026-11-04-1546.json.

Europe: the Commission's agenda: EVP Virkkunen on Centre Stage on 10 November, masterclasses on AI, data spaces, funding and EuroHPC, stands E405, E415, E418 in Pavilion 4 (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu).
Europe: the Dutch delegation, with an NL Lounge and a networking event on 11 November (english.rvo.nl).
Announcements: the 2026 Gender in Tech report; 84% report women in leadership at their company (websummit.com/blog/news/).
Nothing new on websummit.com/blog or portugalstartupnews.com since the 12:55 run; still no source for Portugal's stand size or a government announcement.

desk_runs.title: a new session; the captures move into the vault
lines: This session replaces the earlier researcher session of 4 November; its key is `researcher-vicky-2`, linked to the operator's key (data/keys.json; the old key `researcher-vicky` is retired).
vault@web-summit.vicky sealed the research vault key to the new key, as asked in people/vicky/requests/2026-11-04-vault-research-key-reseal.md; it opened in this session.

21 captures went into the research vault, one file per source, captures/2026-11-04-<short-name>.md: the 22 captures of the 12:55 and 15:46 runs, the two of websummit.com/essentials/venue/ as one (sources and read times as in people/vicky/newsroom/researcher/).

Audited before the push: vault-audit.mjs clean, and a separate security sub-agent passed every file against PUBLIC.md rules 1 to 4; the line is in the vault's PUBLIC.md audit table. sgit status: in sync with the remote.
Not done: the bodies are the earlier runs' summaries; exact quotes were not added, as no source was re-read this run (the research vault, captures/).

desk_runs.title: the summit, Portugal, announcements
lines: 4 captures went into the research vault, audited (vault-audit.mjs clean, security sub-agent pass) and pushed; sgit status in sync.

The summit: Metro de Lisboa's Web Summit Transport Pass, 3 days 23 euros, 5 days 31.50 euros, sold only at the airport accreditation area, 7 to 10 November (metrolisboa.pt); Metro adds Red and Green line service and station surveillance for about 75,000 participants (executivedigest.sapo.pt, 4 Nov). The two disagree …
Portugal: Técnico (ULisboa) at stand E272, Pavilion 2, 10 to 12 November, with robots, a VR demo and six spin-offs (tecnico.ulisboa.pt, 29 Oct).
Announcements: ApexBrasil brings about 200 Brazilian companies, with a 324 m2 pavilion in the MEO Arena (executivedigest.sapo.pt, 4 Nov).
Nothing new since the earlier runs on websummit.com/blog or portugalstartupnews.com; no exact quotes added yet to the 21 earlier captures.

desk_runs.title: first run
lines: Mapped the researcher's 22 captures of 4 November (people/vicky/newsroom/researcher/2026-11-04-1255.json and 2026-11-04-1546.json) into 8 groups; the map is desks/curator/2026-11-04-1945.json in the newsroom repository (site v0.1.3).
Not mapped: the research vault, whose read key is not yet listed in people/vicky/vaults.json; per the researcher's report its 21 captures are these same 22, so nothing is lost until it is.

Seven story candidates for Indi's journalist: the participant's first day, Europe in Pavilion 4, Road 2 Web Summit, Portuguese startups raising, the summit in numbers, the Gender in Tech report, and items for the Portugal banner (desks/curator/2026-11-04-1945.json, story_candidates).

No noise dropped; three overlaps grouped, not dropped (the two venue captures, the two Road 2 Web Summit sources, HaDEA's stand said twice); ticket prices kept as reference, not a story (same file, duplicates_and_noise).

Gaps for the researcher: Portugal's stand, a government announcement, this year's Road 2 cohort, whether the funded startups are at the summit, the rest of the programme, other delegations, and the team's companies (same file, gaps_for_the_researcher); the curator's key is on the keys page as curator-vicky …

desk_runs.title: the research vault, first read
lines: Read the research vault with its read key (people/vicky/vaults.json, v0.2.342): 25 captures, 21 already mapped from the earlier files and 4 new; the map is desks/curator/2026-11-04-1955.json in the newsroom repository (site v0.1.4).

New story candidates: S8 Técnico brings robots and six spin-offs to Web Summit (the research vault/2026-11-04-tecnico-web-summit-2026.md) and S9 about 200 Brazilian companies in Lisbon (captures/2026-11-04-apexbrasil-delegation.md).

For the fact-checker: Metro's page mentions a one-day online pass that Executive Digest says does not exist this year, and Web Summit's page lists one too; S1 gives only the 3 and 5 day passes until checked (captures/2026-11-04-metro-web-summit-transport-pass.md and metro-web-summit-service.md).

Revised: S5 now uses the survey's own wording with both its 55% and 60%, as conductor@web-summit.vicky noted (team site commit 6227e330); S7 can say RTBEAMTECH is at the summit with Técnico (same map, revisions_to_the_first_map).
Gaps for the researcher: the one-day pass, what Técnico's six spin-offs do, and the first map's open gaps (same map, gaps_for_the_researcher).

desk_runs.title: first run
lines: The agenda to Thursday 12 November is live: 210 items (registration days and places, Opening Night, Night Summit, every Centre Stage session, PITCH, all 15 press conferences, the team's picks), each with its source URL and read time, all read on 4 November (desks/programme/agenda.json in the newsroom repository, …

For whoever keeps data/events.json: at the source today, 16 of its 80 sessions have new times and 3 no longer open at the recorded address; the agenda uses today's times and lists the 3 under gaps (desks/programme/agenda.json, "gaps").

Announcements on the summit's schedule: Web Summit's CEO's press conference Wed 11 Nov 11:00, PITCH final Thu 12 Nov 12:30 and winner 15:00, the Road 2 Web Summit winner Thu 12 Nov 12:30 (websummit.com/schedule/, read 4 Nov 20:02 UTC; agenda.json, kind "announcement").

Interview shortlist: 10 names ready (brief 9, decision 6), held only in this desk's session, outside both repositories, until the shortlist vault's key reaches it (people/vicky/reports/vault.md, 4 Nov).
This desk's key is on the keys page as programme-vicky, and vault@web-summit.vicky was told in that commit (data/keys.json, commit 141b694, site v0.2.346).

desk_runs.title: the shortlist in its vault
lines: The shortlist vault's key reached this desk, sealed to programme-vicky by vault@web-summit.vicky, and opened to a file without being shown (its AUDIT.md, line of 20:32 UTC).

The interview shortlist is now held only in that confidential vault: 10 names proposed and 4 reserves, one file each per its template; the local copy outside the repositories is deleted (the vault's AUDIT.md).
vault-audit.mjs before the push: clean, 5 revisions, 8 actual values compared; pushed, in sync with the remote (admin/tools/vault-audit.mjs, run from this repository).
